bosses.name: Soul Block
bosses.strategy:
Yes, I know, Yuri's level is insanely high, but blame the game for not
letting you be able to take him out of your party so you can level others
up. It shouldn't affect much, as he's just as much of a powerhouse ten
levels earlier.

In any case, the Soul Block CANNOT be harmed physically, so it'll be up
to your special attacks to take him out. He has some really strong
physical attacks, as well as the light spell, Pulse, and the Shockwave
spell, neither of which are quite as strong, but hit everyone.

Fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting For Everyone
to boost your party, then have him continually cast For Tomorrow. (Just
know that For Everyone ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster
ring, so if you can't keep up with it, don't worry about casting it to
begin with.)

Have Alice use Advent and have Margarete use Diving Bomber; whoever is
dealing the least amount of damage (likely Alice), have her replenish
Yuri's MP with Mana Roots every other round. Yuri's For Tomorrow SHOULD
keep your party healed, but in case it falls behind, have Alice ready
with an Arc to bring you back up to snuff.

If you're having trouble with the hit areas of the SeraphicRadiance, then
you may want to start using Bronze Daggers (or Arrowheads for just Yuri)
on your party to widen the hit areas. If you're STILL having trouble,
then you'll probably be better of using Amon and his Demon Rays spell.

bosses.name: Hate
bosses.strategy:
Hate will use Hate Storm and Black Fog, but luckily we have Crucifixes
now, so as long as they're equipped, we'll just receive minor to decent
damage to the whole party instead of ring anomalies and poison. It'll
also attempt to paralyze you, but will do a decent amount of damage to a
single ally instead.

Fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting For Everyone
to boost your party, then have him continually attack from there on,
using Third Keys if you have spares, with Alice's Holy Edge on him.
(Remember, For Everyone ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster
ring, so if you can't keep up with it, don't worry about casting it to
begin with.)

Have Alice start off by casting Holy Edge on both Yuri and Margarete,
then use Advent when healing isn't needed, and have her use Arc when it
is. Margarete should be attacking physically as well with Third Keys.
This boss is actually a lot easier than the last.

bosses.name: Scapegoat
bosses.strategy:
The Scapegoat will use Wind Fang that will hit your whole party for a
small amount of damage, and will also attack normally on a single ally
for decent damage. He can also use Deathtouch, which if you remember,
instantly puts an ally into critical HP status, so make sure to heal
straight away when he uses it.

As usual, fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting
For Everyone to boost your party, then have him continually attack from
there on, using Third Keys if you have spares. (Remember, For Everyone
ALSO boosts your AGL, and that means a faster ring, so if you can't keep
up with it, don't worry about casting it to begin with.)

Have Alice use Advent when healing isn't needed, and have her use Arc
when it is. Margarete should be attacking physically as well with Third
Keys. Just make sure to stay healed and you should be fine.

bosses.name: Messiah, Meta-God
bosses.strategy:
He will start the battle off with Holy Chest, which would normally dampen
your SP, but with the Will Powers equipped, it'll only do a decent amount
of damage. He will also use the !!! attack, so make sure that you heal
IMMEDIATELY after it hits so you don't lose your ally. Other than that,
he just uses Status Abnormality, which won't do hardly any damage, and as
long as you have a Crucifix on, you don't need to worry about the
anomalies.

He can also heal himself with Grace, and even though it only SAYS 999 HP
is healed, trust me, a lot more than that is healed. There is no cap on
the damage or amount healed; just the numbers displayed.

As usual, fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance and start off by casting
For Everyone to boost your party, then have him continually attack from
there on, using Third Keys. There is one more battle after this, so save
your Fifth and Seventh Keys for that. (Remember, For Everyone ALSO boosts
your AGL, and that means a faster ring, so if you can't keep up with it,
don't worry about casting it to begin with.)

Alice will most likely be casting Arc every round, but whenever she
happens to get a free turn, have her cast Advent. Margarete should be
attacking physically as well with Third Keys.

Make your way up the stairs to the east. As the path forks, continue west,
following the path to the next area. Move up to and examine the red beams here,
and you'll be told that you cannot pass. Head back to the last fork and make
your way up the stairs to the north.

Follow the path to the next room, where your party will split up to search.
Yuri causes the beams to come down, but by doing so ends up grapping himself,
so now you must choose a party of the remaining members, minus Yuri and anotherparty member. (I ended up using Alice, Zhuzhen, and Halley.)

Go back out to the fork and head west back to the beams, which are now gone, so
you can continue west to the next area. Keep climbing the stairs until you
reach a room with three paths and a glowing triangle button in the center of
the room. Choose option 2 here to release the beams around Yuri.

As Yuri, make your way back out to the fork and wall the way west to meet back
with your party. After you re-choose your party, take the northern path to the
next area, following along to the next area as well.

  NOTE     Put your party in the back row; you can't physically attack in the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   next battle.

When you're ready, approach the beast in the center of the area that blocks
your way.

Use the Save Point, then head northwest and climb the short stairs here to come
to a chest containing a [_SEAL OF AURA_]. Go back down the short stairs, but
follow this walkway down as it goes counter clockwise, and you'll find the last
[_LOTTERY TICKET_] in the game. Return to the center and take the upper-right
path, following it straight up another short staircase to find some
[_BRSRKR EARRINGS_].

Return to the center area once again and take the middle-right path to the
walkway, all the way to a thin green beam going up. Walk through it to activate
it, then go back to the center area, then south back down to the previous floor
to the fork with the glowing triangle button. Go down and take the western path
now, and the green beam that was once here is now gone, allowing you to get the
[_CRANK SLINGSHOT_] out of the chest here. Return back to the second floor and
to the center area.

Use the Points again if you like, then take the upper-right path once again,
then continue up the stairs to the left. Of the two paths here, take the one on
the right first to the next area. At the four-way fork here, go northwest and
open the chest here for a [_SEAL OF VITALITY_], then go back to the fork and
head northeast, where you'll come across another beam going up. Walk through
the blue beam to activate it, then return back to the previous room with the
Points.

Make your way back to the center area, then take the middle-right path once
again, this time climbing the stairs one set above the ones to the lower-right,
and continue northeast to the next area. At the fork here, take the lower-right
path and run through the red beam to activate it, then go back and take the
upper-left path that is now open where the blue beams once were, following the
path to a dead-end with two chests; a [_SILVERTHREADCOAT_] and a
[_SAGE STAFF_].

Return to the center area with the Points one last time. SAVE YOUR GAME, then
take the northeastern path once again. At the two northern doors, take the
western one this time to the next area. At the fork here, go northeast to
another dead-end, but also with two more chests; a [_RUBBER SUIT_], and more
[_MONK EARRINGS_]. Make your way back out to the fork.

  NOTE     Equip Crucifixes on each of your party members for the next boss.

After the battle, the same three Points will appear once again, so Save, then
continue up the stairs to the north to the next area. Keep following along
through two corridors until you reach a new room and a staircase. Climb the
stairs to the next area, where you'll be warped to a different location of the
castle.

  NOTE     In this area, try to get some TalismansOfPower from the Red Caps.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
After a quick discussion among the group, head up the northern stairs to the
next area, warping once again. Climb the short yellow stairs to the north, then
head west to a fork of stairs; go up the stairs, then walk to the left as far
as you can to warp to the next area. Open the chest to your right for the
[_HERETIC'S COAT_], then return through the warp to the previous area.

Return to the fork of stairs and descend the other set, then follow the path as
it goes south to the next area. Follow the path here until you warp once again.
Go west from here to find a hidden chest on this balcony that contains a
[_MIND'S EYE_], then descend the stairs here to warp once again. Follow this
path west and through a door to return to the area where you first warped to.

Head north once again to the next area and follow the path to the warp, once
again. Climb the short yellow stairs, but this time, go east and southeast to
warp back to the very first warp, but on the other side. Open the chest on this
platform for a [_TALISMANOFPOWER_], then go west to the next area.

DO NOT GO UNDERNEATH THE STAIRS TO THE NORTHWEST, or you'll have to start over
again! Instead, climb the stairs here, opening the chest above you for a
[_V-BLADE-BLODAUTH_]. Continue climbing to find another warp, which will let
you open the chest you saw earlier; it has a [_FIFTH KEY_]. That's it for
treasure, so take a few steps west to warp for the last time, then head north
across the bridge to the next area.

When you're ready, approach the freaky looking demon that's waiting for you.
